name: Exclusiv Access
description: Provides a light, content-by-content access limitation by token.
project_description:
About 
 This module provide a light access control solution.

 There is not a "global access control" or a "access security solution" but a "content-by-content" solution

 Use Case 
 
 The use case are a little site, without real dev team, without client access control. 
 The site have a minimalist syndication like "manuel newsletter" and admin want share new content with newsletter subscriber first. 
 On these contents, admin activate Exclusiv Access, and share content with token to subscribers. 
 Several days after, Exclusiv Access are desactivated, and content are full access. 
 
 How use it 
 Just follow steps:

 
 Activate module 
 Edit an fieldable entity bundle and add the "Exclusiv Access" field. 
 When creating or editing content, open "Exclusiv access control" tab. 
 Save content, and a message show you the tokenised URL. 
 
 Permission 
 A custom permission are present for seeing "Exclusiv" content without token.

 Back to top
